title: Exclude 'Not Graded' assignments from grade impact calculator totals

comments.author: empire-pa\amathias
comments.text: PROBLEM: When clicking an assignment on class pages to view grade impact, the modal shows current grade and projected grade if you get 100%. However, the computeTotals() function is including assignments with status='not-graded' in the calculation, treating them as 0 earned points. This skews the current grade lower than it should be. LOCATION: src/pages/classes/[classId].astro lines 494-507 computeTotals() function. Currently does: earned = assignment.score === null ? 0 : assignment.score. SOLUTION: Skip assignments with status='not-graded' entirely from both earned and possible totals. Only include graded, missing, and pending assignments. EXAMPLE: If a class has graded assignments totaling 50/50 but also has a not-graded assignment worth 40 points, current calculation shows 50/90=55.6% when it should show 50/50=100%.
